plugins.name: voice-grill
plugins.description: A voice-first interviewer in the spirit of grill-me / grilling. Just talk through voice input (Aqua Voice and similar); it asks up to 5 numbered questions per round to draw out and sharpen your thinking, then writes the article or plans and executes the work. Replies in your language.
